what_this_is: Differences between the incumbent's retained reading and the replacement's, settled by reading the page. An entry never rewrites the retained bytes and never changes the exact regression result; it records that a person looked at the source and says which reading the document supports (ADR-0023).
evidence: WSDOT 9540 utility listings, page 1 of each. Reproduce with: render the registered rendition and read the header band above the instrument-code and number columns.

adjudications.verdict: The page prints one merged header cell over two data columns: the instrument code (EP, EF) and its number (30474C, Fife Ordinance 2001). The header says "AND NUMBER" because it names both, and a vertical rule separates them on every data row. The replacement counts two unmapped columns and repeats the shared header text for each; the incumbent counted one and undercounted the page. The replacement matches the document, so its reading is accepted.
